Deliberately **not** mirrored here: the screencast (deposited at OSF PGDR6), MCP tarballs, and the tool itself (it has its own public repository). This folder is a distillation record of the venue submission, not a tool distribution.

## Relation to the research programme

The demonstrated tool is the practitioner-facing consumer of the programme's artefacts: AppSec Core v1 typed ontology (P6, OSF 10.17605/OSF.IO/U9CRD), the coverage-preserving compilation method and corpus (P7/P8), and the retrieval regime specified in P3 (OSF 10.17605/OSF.IO/S3HET). It demonstrates, in daily-workflow form, the grounding value that the pre-registered companion study P4 (OSF registration 10.17605/OSF.IO/H5AJE) evaluates with the stricter apparatus specified in P5 (OSF 10.17605/OSF.IO/KH8Y7).

See the repository-root `SUBMITTED-PEER-REVIEWED.md` for the index of venue submissions surfaced publicly.
